text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to the shrine with Daiichi Ruby, 
who hasn't been doing well lately, 
accompanied by her butler, but――

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
A torii gate is a barrier that separates 
the divine realm from the world we live 
in. Be sure to bow whenever you pass 
through one.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Is something the matter?
choice_data_list:
No, I was just thinking your manners are 
impeccable.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Our clan often visits shrines together, so 
I learned it at an early age.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, this is not to pray... or cling 
to hope. It is only by one's own power 
that a path is forged.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
A shrine is a place to face your 
convictions once more. That is precisely 
why we must observe the proper etiquette 
from start to finish.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I shall go and pay my respects 
at the shrine.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Are you finished as well, Trainer? If so—

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it isn't Lady Ruby. Thank you very 
much for visiting the shrine.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Head Priest. I was just on my way to the 
shrine office to pay my respects."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I watched her with genuine admiration, 
not just for her manners, but for her 
polite greeting...

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Butler
text_block_list.text:
“Cherish the bonds between people...” The 
Grand Master often did things like that 
too.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Father
text_block_list.text:
Head Priest, Happy New Year. I look 
forward to your continued favor in the 
year ahead.

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well. Despite how busy you are, to 
go to such polite lengths..."

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor
text_block_list.text:
Are those people from the "Illustrious 
Clan"...? Going out of their way to make 
the rounds and give greetings all the way 
out here, they truly are remarkable folks!

text_block_list.name: Young Ruby
text_block_list.text: ! ...Is this... a connection...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"We have greeted the head priest, and with 
that, all shrine visit rituals are 
complete. Let us head back."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby seemed to view greetings and 
formalities as mere etiquette, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Someday, a day will likely come when we 
can interact in the true sense my father 
spoke of. With that hope in mind, they 
left the shrine behind."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—*SHHHHAAAAAA!*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Suddenly, rain began to fall! It was 
supposed to be clear all day today, 
but..."
choice_data_list:
I've got kind of a bad feeling about 
this...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"It's just a natural phenomenon. Let's 
head inside and call a car."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, completely soaked by the sudden 
downpour, Daiichi Ruby struggled to get 
back into top form for some time 
afterwards...
